ROUTE: Lapwing-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior routing rationale: the query is a precisely-specified algebra problem with a single correct answer and clear completion criteria, which falls squarely in Lapwing's self-reported top-rated task family (well-defined retrieval/extraction/computation). Since capability evals are essentially tied across the fleet on this kind of task (differences under 2.0 points are noise), I broke the tie by routing to the model that prefers this task type. Dunlin, by contrast, prefers open-ended generative work and gets no benefit from a closed-form math question, so Lapwing was the better match.
